title: Light Page Section
description: The default page band: a base (white) background with neutral-700 body copy. On the live site this is the plain `.lsx-block-container` — the homepage alternates it with the tinted band all the way down the page. Vertical padding is preset 70, which lands on the ~64-71px the live containers resolve to at 1440px (they use percentage padding, so the block theme pins it to the spacing scale instead).
